status: EXACT SCALAR RELAXATION COUNTERMODEL; NOT A GRAM MATRIX
scope: The 12 support weights and support Gram matrix are realized by the exact sparse D5 weighted design. The 29 formal zero-point height profiles satisfy every individual weighted mean/second-moment equation, all pairwise weighted cross-moment kissing inequalities, the strict tail bounds, every support-support-zero 3x3 Gram determinant, and every support-zero-zero 3x3 Gram determinant. They do not satisfy the common five-dimensional support column-space equations; rank 7 is the deliberately exposed missing condition.
